legend: «Next please», — the princess called and cast an estimating glance at the next groom.

The princess intends to choose the most worthy groom, this is, the richest one. Whenever she sees a groom who is more rich than each of the previous ones, she says a measured «Oh...». Whenever the groom is richer than all previous ones added together, she exclaims «Wow!» (no «Oh...» in this case). At the sight of the first groom the princess stays calm and says nothing.

The fortune of each groom is described with an integer between 1 and 50000. You know that during the day the princess saw n grooms, said «Oh...» exactly a times and exclaimed «Wow!» exactly b times. Your task is to output a sequence of n integers t1, t2, ..., tn, where ti describes the fortune of i-th groom. If several sequences are possible, output any of them. If no sequence exists that would satisfy all the requirements, output a single number -1.
input: The only line of input data contains three integer numbers n, a and b (1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 0 ≤ a, b ≤ 15, n > a + b), separated with single spaces.
output: Output any sequence of integers t1, t2, ..., tn, where ti (1 ≤ ti ≤ 50000) is the fortune of i-th groom, that satisfies the given constraints. If no sequence exists that would satisfy all the requirements, output a single number -1.

legend.ai: “下一位，请。”公主喊道，并估量地看了一眼下一位新郎。
公主打算选择最优秀的新郎，也就是最富有的那一位。每当她看到一位比之前每一位新郎都富有的新郎时，她都会平静地说一声“哦……”。如果这位新郎比之前所有新郎的财富总和还要多，她就会喊道“哇！”（此时不会说“哦……”）。看到第一位新郎时，公主保持平静，什么也不说。
每位新郎的财富都是一个介于 1 和 50000 之间的整数。你知道公主在这一天看到了 n 位新郎，说了恰好 a 次“哦……”，并喊了恰好 b 次“哇！”。你的任务是输出一个由 n 个整数 t1, t2, ..., tn 组成的序列，其中 ti 表示第 i 位新郎的财富。如果存在多个满足条件的序列，输出任意一个即可。如果不存在满足所有要求的序列，输出一个数字 -1。

input.ai: 输入数据的唯一一行包含三个整数 n、a 和 b（1 ≤ n ≤ 100，0 ≤ a, b ≤ 15，n > a + b），它们之间用单个空格分隔。

output.ai: 输出任意一个整数序列 t1, t2, ..., tn，其中 ti（1 ≤ ti ≤ 50000）表示第 i 位新郎的财富，并满足给定的约束条件。如果不存在满足所有要求的序列，则输出一个数字 -1。
